### He Became Poor
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-december-24-2019.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 8:9
Points:
- Christ possessed eternal glory and divine abundance before stepping into human history.
- Fellowship between holy God and fallen humanity was impossible without Christ sharing His wealth.
- By descending into poverty, the Savior imparted His righteousness to raise sinners into communion with Himself.
- Believers are spiritually enriched and welcomed into God's presence through Christ's sacrificial love.

### Threefold Redemption
Author: Joe Holland
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/threefold-redemption
Passage: 2 Corinthians 8:9
Points:
- Biblical redemption unfolds in three dimensions: alluded to in prophecy, accomplished by Christ, and applied to believers.
- The Gospels fulfill prophetic imagery by showing Christ stripped of earthly dignity at the cross.
- New Testament epistles demonstrate how Christ's accomplished redemption transforms practical daily conduct.
- Recognizing that the Lord became destitute to save us motivates Christians toward genuine financial generosity.
